analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. Per the patch, the single hunk is at line 2966 on both sides, expanded to 2966-2970 in head. It adds documentation that the control leader's cluster service re-plans after a worker-digest update only once both Macs report the same worker build (ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild), and links the pair's coordinated update. The supplied units (base lines 4003-4494) lie outside the changed range and are unchanged context: GLM and Qwen tensor-parallel and pipeline docs, the encrypted SSD prefix-record encoding, GPT-OSS paged KV, and Gemma batch decode. I found no security-relevant change in them. The hunk is a docs-only description of update sequencing. It alters no code, no trust boundary, no key or attestation handling, no data exposure and no authorization path. The mentioned 600 s wait on a failed plan is an availability note about a version-skew window, not a new attack surface. The stated oneBuild gate is documented as fail-wait rather than fail-open, and it touches no encryption or attestation control. Remaining unverified items, which are outside the supplied evidence: the actual ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild implementation and the linked cluster-always-on.md section. Nothing in this PR evidences a regression, so those remain unverified contracts and no finding is raised. The T-041 prefix-cache SSD posture is described in unchanged text, and the PR does not alter TTL, scope or key derivation.
